requestSummary: Shared popup initializes identically in Chrome and Firefox, then produces deterministic local packages for both targets.

criteria.requirement: Shared popup must initialize and display expected identity/status in Chrome and Firefox.
criteria.acceptance: Both tailored browser scenarios assert heading, ready text, and initialized marker, then report REQ-001.

criteria.requirement: Verified source must produce deterministic unsigned Chrome and Firefox packages.
criteria.acceptance: Package report matches current source, covers both targets, and independently validated ZIP hashes/layouts pass.
